title: Port the full EPP browser shell and navigation
goal: Replace the seed-only document list with the full EPP browser shell, grouped nav, search, library selector, document routing, and Appendix A visibility.
acceptance_criteria: The app reads full EPP workspace manifests, document metadata, and document payloads through the local service instead of static seed imports
The left nav exposes the EPP display groups and counts from the old browser
Appendices can be expanded and Appendix A can be opened as a normal document
Survey Guidance and CFR layers are represented in the library selector
The UI follows the old DOVAXIS/EPP document-first layout baseline
non_goals: Final renderer parity for every artifact
validation: Smoke /api/workspaces and document-read endpoints against epp-full
Open the app and verify Appendix A is visible under Appendices
notes: This should come before deeper workbook UI polish because workbook affordances need to attach to visible documents. SG-0002 is absorbed here so the browser shell is built on the durable local service boundary from the start.
